choose.when: select v.* from (select r.* from hls_bp_master hbm, hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master_reply r where hbm.bp_id = #{manufacturerId} and hbm.bp_id = hcl.bp_id and hcl.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and hcl.company_id = #{request.companyId} and r.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and r.latest_flag = 'Y' order by r.creation_date desc)v where 1 = 1 and rownum = 1
choose.otherwise: select v.* from (select r.* from hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_master_relation hbmr, hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master_reply r where hbm.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id and hbm.bp_id = #{factoryId} and hbmr.relation_type = 'MANUFACTURER' and hbmr.related_bp_id = hcl.bp_id and hcl.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and hcl.company_id = #{request.companyId} and r.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and r.latest_flag = 'Y' order by r.creation_date desc)v where 1 = 1 and rownum = 1

mapper.select:
select v.*, (select hbrp.default_value from hls_bp_reply_para hbrp where hbrp.reply_id = v.reply_id and hbrp.reply_para = 'INSURANCE_FREE_AMOUNT' ) insurance_free_amount, (select hbrp.default_value from hls_bp_reply_para hbrp where hbrp.reply_id = v.reply_id and hbrp.reply_para = 'INSURANCE_FREE_PERIOD' ) insurance_free_period
from (select r.* from hls_bp_master hbm, hls_bp_master_relation hbmr, hls_credit_line hcl, hls_bp_master_reply r where hbm.bp_id = hbmr.bp_id and hbm.bp_id = #{factoryId} and hbmr.relation_type = 'MANUFACTURER' and hbmr.related_bp_id = hcl.bp_id and hcl.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y' and hcl.company_id = #{request.companyId} and r.credit_line_id = hcl.credit_line_id and r.latest_flag = 'Y' order by r.creation_date desc)v where 1 = 1 and rownum = 1

SELECT hbm.reply_code, hbm.cyclic_amount, hbm.not_cyclic_amount, hbm.reply_amount, to_char(hbm.valid_from,'YYYY-MM-DD') valid_from_n, to_char(hbm.valid_to,'YYYY-MM-DD') valid_to_n, hbm.floating_range_method, hbm.latest_flag, hbm.bear_guarantee_flag, hbm.reply_id, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'CON.FLOATING_RANGE_METHOD' AND v.code_value = hbm.floating_range_method) floating_range_method_n, hbm.GUARANTEE_METHOD, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'GUARANTEE_METHOD' AND v.code_value = hbm.GUARANTEE_METHOD) GUARANTEE_METHOD_N FROM hls_bp_master_reply hbm
hbm.credit_line_id = #{creditLineId}
select * from (SELECT * FROM hls_bp_master_reply hbm where hbm.credit_line_id = #{creditLineId} order by hbm.creation_date desc) where rownum = 1
SELECT * FROM hls_bp_master_reply hbm where hbm.credit_line_id = #{creditLineId} and hbm.latest_flag = 'Y'

select hbm.*, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'CON.FLOATING_RANGE_METHOD' AND v.code_value = hbm.floating_range_method) floating_range_method_n from prj_quotation quo, hls_reply_product hrp, hls_bp_master_reply hbm, hls_product_definition hpd where quo.plan_id = hpd.definition_id and hpd.reply_product_id = hrp.reply_product_id and hrp.reply_id = hbm.reply_id and quo.QUOTATION_ID = #{quotationId}

select hbrp.vaule_to, hbmr.latest_flag, hbmr.valid_from, hbmr.creation_date,hbrp.reply_para from hls_bp_reply_para hbrp,hls_bp_master_reply hbmr,hls_credit_line hcl where hbrp.reply_id=hbmr.reply_id and hbmr.credit_line_id=hcl.credit_line_id and hcl.P_CREDIT_LINE_ID is null and hcl.bp_id=#{bpId}
